title: 第13章 进阶大哥布林第14章 建设
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
第2天，太阳重新升起，哥布林部落换了新领袖。
作为现在哥布林中最高最壮的李秦武，他当仁不让的上位。
身为一个拥有人类灵魂的哥布林，他自然不会让哥布林部落处于混沌状态，他给哥布林们进行分组，一半人去狩猎队，30为一组，有5组，向四面八方分散出去找猎物。
李秦武警告他们，打到的猎物必须要带回来让他分配，谁要是敢私吞猎物，会死的很惨！
剩下一半人成了工作队，李秦武给他们的第1个任务是去刨坑，把之前吃红毒果死掉的30多具尸体埋了。
tmd，这些尸体在部落里待了两天，都发臭了，前任首领是真牛逼，一点管的意思都没有。
哥布林这种生物虽然像蟑螂一样耐活，可他们也是会生病死人的，要是尸体滋生瘟疫，一波就能给他们送走！
安排好任务，李秦武招募了7个哥布林，把昨天的损失补上，然后带着19个兵去狩猎角鳄。
昨天已经证明过了，用红毒果猎杀角鳄非常有效。
这一整天，李秦武就在疯狂的捕猎中度过，死在他手里的角鳄数量达到了21只，他直接升到了10级，活力从8来到12，他的身高来到1米8，就算在大哥布林中，也算长得比较高的存在了。
与此同时，跑动技能被他点满到5级，多出来的专精点全点在了单手武器上。
现在他获得一把铁质武器斧头，打算好好练练单手武器熟练度，之后可能用得上。
猎杀到傍晚就停止了，李秦武让众哥布林齐心协力，把今天杀死的角鳄翻了个面，他用斧头从角鳄的腹部刨开，将一整张角鳄皮剥了下来。
角鳄的皮革可是非常珍贵的甲胄原料，现在有铁器，必须把它们全部收集起来！
角鳄的角也被他用斧背砸了下来，同样妥善保存。
这一整天的刷怪，系统爆的东西，加现实从角鳄身上取的东西如下。
谷物x42
角鳄皮x37
角鳄角x5
角鳄筋x11

第纳尔1890
如此大的收获，让李秦武乐的见牙不见眼，不过让他纠结的是，地上这么多角鳄尸体，他们的肉还可以吃吗？
这些角鳄都是李秦武用红毒果毒死的，红毒果表现的毒性有些逆天，这东西恐怕是种魔法植物，不然毒性不会这么烈。
可眼巴前21条角鳄尸体，他实在不忍心放在这里腐烂。
他以前看过纪录片，说很多自然界的毒素高温加热后，蛋白质会被破坏，失去毒性，他不知道这条法则到异世界还通不通用。
他打算将肉处理过后让人试吃，看会不会毒死人。
李秦武弄了块角鳄肉，用水洗的干干净净，插在树枝上放在火上烤，直接给它烤成肉干，烤到牙口不好都嚼不动那种。
李秦武把哥布大叫过来。
“你今天表现勇敢，赏你一根肉串！”
李秦武丝毫没有道德负担，将肉串递给哥布大。
哥布大一脸惊喜，几口将肉串吃了个精光。
李秦武直勾勾盯着哥布大，哥布大也直勾勾的盯着李秦武。
“你有什么特殊感觉吗？”
李秦武问。
哥布大挠了挠脸。
content_en:
On the second day, the sun rose again, and the Goblin tribe had a new leader.
As Li Qinwu, the tallest and strongest among the Goblins, he took the throne without hesitation.
As a goblin with a human soul, he naturally would not let the goblin tribe be in a state of chaos. He divided the goblins into groups, and half of them went into hunting teams. There were 5 groups of 30 in each group, and they spread out in all directions to find prey.
Li Qinwu warned them that the prey they caught must be brought back for him to distribute. Anyone who dares to steal the prey will die miserably!
The remaining half of the people became a work team, and the first task Li Qinwu gave them was to dig a hole and bury more than 30 bodies that had died after eating the red poison fruit.
Tmd, these corpses have been in the tribe for two days and they all stink. The former leader was really awesome and had no intention of caring about them at all.
Although creatures like Goblins are as durable as cockroaches, they can also get sick and die. If the corpse breeds plague, they can be sent away in one wave!
After arranging the task, Li Qinwu recruited 7 goblins to make up for yesterday's losses, and then led 19 soldiers to hunt horned crocodiles.
It was proven yesterday that using red poison fruit to hunt horned crocodiles is very effective.
This whole day, Li Qinwu spent the whole day in crazy hunting. The number of horned crocodiles that died in his hands reached 21. He was directly promoted to level 10, his vitality increased from 8 to 12, and his height reached 1.8 meters. Even among the big goblins, he was considered to be relatively tall.
At the same time, his running skill was maxed out to level 5, and all the extra focus points were used on one-handed weapons.
Now that he has obtained an iron weapon ax, he plans to practice his one-handed weapon proficiency, which may be useful in the future.
The hunting stopped in the evening. Li Qinwu asked all the goblins to work together to turn over the horned crocodile killed today. He used an ax to slice open the horned crocodile's abdomen and peel off the entire horned crocodile skin.
The leather of the horned crocodile is a very precious raw material for armor. Now that there are iron tools, we must collect them all!
The horns of the horned crocodile were also smashed off by him with the back of an axe, and were also well preserved.
During this whole day of spawning monsters, the things that exploded in the system, and the things that were taken from the horned crocodile are as follows.
Cerealx42
Horned crocodile skin x37
Crocodile horn x5
Crocodile Tendon x11
Dinar 1890
Such a huge harvest made Li Qin Wule blind, but what troubled him was that there were so many horned crocodile carcasses on the ground, could their meat still be eaten?
These horned crocodiles were poisoned by Li Qinwu with the red poison fruit. The poison of the red poison fruit was a bit unnatural. I am afraid this thing is a magic plant, otherwise the poison would not be so strong.
But in front of him were 21 horned crocodile corpses, and he really couldn't bear to leave them here to rot.
He has seen documentaries before, saying that when many natural toxins are heated to high temperatures, their proteins will be destroyed and lose their toxicity. He doesn't know if this rule still applies to other worlds.
He planned to process the meat and let people try it to see if it would poison people.
Li Qinwu made a piece of horned crocodile meat, washed it clean with water, put it on a tree branch, roasted it over the fire, and roasted it directly into dried meat. It was roasted until it was hard for the teeth to chew.
Li Qinwu called Gobu over.
"For your bravery today, I will reward you with a meat skewer!"
Li Qinwu had no moral burden at all and handed the meat skewers to Cobuda.
Gobuda looked surprised and ate all the meat skewers in a few mouthfuls.
Li Qinwu stared directly at Cobuda, and Cobuda also stared directly at Li Qinwu.
"Do you feel anything special?"
Li Qinwu asked.
Gobuda scratched his face.
